subject: Pilot continuity: ask for extension & dev-credit buffer — CloudWard integration delay
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena@cloudward.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-29T11:12:00-05:00
Subject: Integration stall — asking for pilot runway & dev credit buffer

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineers started the adapter work over the weekend and hit an unexpected auth handshake issue with our SSO provider. It's going to take at least one more sprint to resolve (estimate: 2–3 weeks) and that pushes our pilot timeline out.

We'd like to request:
- A 3-week extension on the pilot window, and
- A small dev credit buffer (tokens) so our engineers can continue testing without interruption while we sort the auth issue.

This pilot is high priority for us but the delay is purely integration work on our side. Can you let me know if Redwood can accommodate a short runway extension and a one-off credit? Happy to share the logs and jump on a quick sync.

Appreciate it —
Elena Ramos
Head of Platform Integrations
CloudWard
[Attachment: integration-log-snippet.txt (text/plain, 14KB)]

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the log snippet. Sorry to hear the SSO handshake is blocking you. We value this pilot and want to keep momentum.

Quick plan:
- I'll loop in Kimberly (SE) to review the logs and advise a targeted test pattern so we don't waste tokens.
- Marissa (CS) will help coordinate weekly check-ins while engineering works through the fix.
- I'll escalate a discretionary credit/extension ask to Ben (sales lead) and include a proposed mutual action plan.

Can you confirm the earliest available time tomorrow for a 30-min technical sync (Elena + your lead eng + Kimberly)? Also confirm whether CloudWard needs the extension to be calendar-based (dates) or sprint-based (number of weeks).

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / team — I dug through the log snippet Mateo forwarded and pulled a quick repro. The behavior looks consistent with a dropped token exchange when the SSO IdP returns a nonstandard redirect envelope; we should be able to scope a small test harness to reproduce without running the full end-to-end pilot.

Recommendations:
- Temporary 14-day pilot extension to avoid customer-facing gaps while your engineers fix the IdP mapping.
- One-off dev credit: 50k tokens allocated to a sandbox endpoint with strict usage limits (we'll lock it to your test IPs).
- Run the attached mutual action plan (short checklist) during the extension:
  * Week 0: tech sync + repro confirmation
  * Week 1: targeted fixes + validation tests (we provide test vectors)
  * Week 2: final verification + production rollout window

I've attached a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx and included an extracted log snippet with inline notes. If CloudWard prefers a 3-week sprint-based extension instead of 14 calendar days, I'm fine with that — call it 2–3 weeks depending on how your sprint cadence lines up.

Next steps: please confirm a sync time and whether you want the tokens visible as a sandbox coupon or applied to the pilot account.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28KB)]

Date: 2026-11-30T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: discretionary pilot extension + credit (CloudWard RDW-2381)

Team / Elena — I reviewed the ask and Kimberly's assessment. Approve the following on a discretionary basis to keep the pilot on track:
- Pilot extension: 21 calendar days (3 weeks) from 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-21.
- Dev credit: 50,000 tokens allocated to CloudWard's sandbox environment.
- Conditions: weekly 30-min syncs with Redwood SE + CS for the duration; usage limited to test endpoints we agree on; no rollover beyond the extension window.

I'll issue a short approval memo and attach it here. Marissa, please create the HubSpot task and set up the calendar invites for recurring weekly check-ins starting 2026-12-01. Mateo, confirm whether Elena wants the credit as a coupon code or account-applied credit so we can provision.

Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference

Best,
